Jethalal gets furious after Tapu Sena accidentally makes Madhavi’s ₹20,000 vanish while performing a magic trick. When Jethalal threatens to call the police to teach Tapu a lesson, the entire society steps in to defend the children.
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
